|strategy=By [mailto:zube@eagle.cc.ukans.edu Nick Zube]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/queenamidalarulerofnaboo.html</ref>

You've seen her in her Handmaiden outfit, now see her in her full geisha glory. [[Queen Amidala]] is back in town, and the Senate will never be the same!

Just like her Padm&eacute; Naberrie persona, Amidala has very well-rounded stats, even for a Light Side character. A high destiny draw, excellent forfeit, decent power, a dash of Politics, and that all-important 4 ability put her over many Light Side characters in almost every desirable category. She's even immune to attrition &lt; 3.

However, unlike Padm&eacute;, who is a key to Jedi battle strategies, the Queen works best in the Senate, pleading for the rights of her downtrodden people. She may not be a Senator, but she still contributes to a senate majority with her 2 Politics. She can even be placed on Political Effects like a Senator. And, like all good little Senators, Amidala gives you an excellent benefit for achieving a senate majority: you can retrieve 1 Force for each [[Naboo]] site you control.

"What?!" you ask. "[[Naboo]]? But... but... this is the [[Coruscant (location) (2){{!}}Coruscant]] set!"

So it is, but you'll find quite a few [[Naboo]] sites lurking behind the scenes in [[Coruscant (location) (2){{!}}Coruscant]]. Not only are there a few great drain sites in the bunch, but you can supplement them with generic sites from Special Edition to create a completely site-based "Celebration" deck that uses the immensely more secure Senate over a beatdown-prone system to achieve its retrieval. Smells like a deck type to me.

Just watch out for [[Darth Maul]]...

Combos:

An extra Force drain bonus and extra Force? Sign me up!

The perfect pair to make your [[Naboo]] ground deck secure and profitable.
